title: Verify: BootScene fades out and starts the scene on transitionTo unit tests
summary: Unit tests with Phaser mocked prove the transitionTo fade-out and scene start.
description: Write a new unit test file with a fake Phaser (modeled on game/frontend/tests/bootScenePlayAnimation.test.ts) whose cameras.main exposes fadeOut and once spies, whose scene exposes start, and which provides Cameras.Scene2D.Events.FADE_OUT_COMPLETE = 'camerafadeoutcomplete'. No browser or real Phaser is used.
acceptance_criteria: fadeOut is called once with TRANSITION_FADE_MS after transitionTo is emitted.
scene.start is not called before the fade-out-complete callback runs and is called once with the sceneId afterwards.
Nothing is called when transitionTo was not emitted.
technical_constraints: Vitest; Phaser fully mocked; content module mocked as in bootScenePlayAnimation.test.ts
definition_of_done: Tests pass in seconds using only the named file

steps.action: Copy the phaser and content mocks from bootScenePlayAnimation.test.ts. Extend the fake Scene with cameras = { main: { fadeIn: vi.fn(), fadeOut: vi.fn(), once: vi.fn() } }, scene = { start: vi.fn() }, and add Cameras: { Scene2D: { Events: { FADE_OUT_COMPLETE: 'camerafadeoutcomplete' } } } to the default export.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneTransition.test.ts -t 'fades the camera out'
steps.expected: BootScene can be constructed and create() runs against the fake.

steps.action: In beforeEach call reactToPhaser.clear(), build a BootScene, set up a store state as bootScenePlayAnimation.test.ts does, and call create().
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneTransition.test.ts -t 'fades the camera out'
steps.expected: Scene subscribed with a clean bus.

steps.symbol: it('fades the camera out on transitionTo')
steps.action: Emit reactToPhaser.emit('transitionTo', { sceneId: 'library' }); assert cameras.main.fadeOut toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1) and toHaveBeenCalledWith(TRANSITION_FADE_MS) imported from BootScene; assert scene.start not called.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneTransition.test.ts -t 'fades the camera out'

steps.symbol: it('starts the scene only after fade-out completes')
steps.action: Emit transitionTo { sceneId: 'library' }; read the callback from cameras.main.once.mock.calls where call[0] === 'camerafadeoutcomplete'; assert scene.start not called; invoke the callback; assert scene.start toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1) with 'library'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneTransition.test.ts -t 'only after fade-out'

steps.symbol: it('does nothing without a transitionTo event')
steps.action: Without emitting, assert fadeOut and scene.start were not called.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneTransition.test.ts
